title: Einstein-Lovelock field equations for a4[x4] and b4[x4] in the corrected primordial metric of 2026-10-16 (version 2; Revision/SPEC.md sections 1 and 5), for general functions a4 and b4 > 0 and every real z = 6 H x0

conventions.metric: g = diag(E^(-2 a4) b4 Cot[z]^2, E^(2 a4) (x3), -1, -E^(-2 a4) b4 (Sin[z]^2)^(1/6) (x3)), z = 6 H x0 real ((Sin^2)^(1/6) the positive branch); the metric of 2026-10-14 and its formulas are withdrawn
conventions.coordinates: the author's coordinates x0..x7: x0 = hidden direction, space-like (scale factor e^{-a4} b4^{1/2} |cot z|); x1, x2, x3 = 3-space (scale factor e^{a4}); x4 = time; x5, x6, x7 = extra times, time-like (scale factor e^{-a4} b4^{1/2} (sin^2 z)^{1/12}); the block (x0, x5, x6, x7) is e^{-2a4} b4 times a space of constant curvature -H^2
conventions.symbols: ad1 = a4'(x4), ad2 = a4''(x4), uu = b4'/b4, vv = (b4'/b4)' (b4''/b4 = vv + uu^2), kk = e^{2 a4}/b4 (so kk' = kk (2 ad1 - uu)), hh = uu/2 - ad1 = h4, the rate of the block (x0, x5, x6, x7); H > 0, alpha1..alpha3 = Lovelock couplings, Lam = Lambda, kappa = gravitational coupling, cc = cot z, tt = tan z; AA, be = the parameters of an exponential history; d4f, d0f = partial derivatives of f with respect to x4, x0
conventions.curvature: MTW: R^a_{bcd} = d_c Gamma^a_{bd} - d_d Gamma^a_{bc} + Gamma^a_{ce} Gamma^e_{bd} - Gamma^a_{de} Gamma^e_{bc}
conventions.fieldEquations: sum_{k=1}^{3} alpha_k E_(k)^mu_nu + Lam delta^mu_nu = kappa T^mu_nu
conventions.source: T^mu_nu = diag(p0, p3, p3, p3, -rho, p_t, p_t, p_t) (order x0..x7); rho = -T^x4_x4, p_mu = T^mu_mu (no sum); the field equations require every off-diagonal component to vanish and p0 = p_t

lovelockTensors.allOtherComponents: x2x2 = x3x3 = x1x1, x0x0 = x5x5 = x6x6 = x7x7; every off-diagonal component is 0; every component is a polynomial in H, ad1, ad2, uu, vv, kk (exact, all 64 components checked)

generalSource.hiddenEqualsExtraTimes: sum_k alpha_k (E^x0_x0 - E^x5_x5) = 0 identically, so kappa (p0 - p_t) = 0: p0 = p_t
generalSource.offDiagonal: 0 = kappa T^mu_nu for every mu != nu (the left-hand sides vanish identically): no off-diagonal source component, in particular T^x4_x0 = T^x0_x4 = 0
generalSource.secondOrderSystem: the x1 and x0 components are linear in (ad2, vv) with Jacobian J; det J below; where det J != 0 they determine a4'' and (b4'/b4)' from the sources, and the x4 component is the constraint
generalSource.x0_dependence: the left-hand sides are free of x0 (and of a4, b4 except through kk), so the source must satisfy d0 rho = d0 p3 = d0 p0 = 0

conservation_x0.tex: -\frac{\cot z^2 q_{04} \left(\frac{u}{2}-(a_4')\right)}{k}+3 \cot z H (p_0-p_t)+\partial_0 p_0+\partial_4 q_{40}+\frac{3 q_{40} u}{2} = 0

generalSource.constraint_propagation: d/dx4 [sum_k alpha_k E^x4_x4] = 3 ad1 (E^x1_x1 - E^x4_x4) + 4 hh (E^x0_x0 - E^x4_x4) identically (the x4 component of the Bianchi identity)

einstein.flatVacuum: a4 = 0, b4 = H^2 (x4 - c)^2 (the flat member of the corrected metric) is a vacuum solution with Lambda = 0
einstein.noExponentialVacuum: no exponential history a4 = AA H x4 + a0, b4 = b4(0) e^(be AA H x4) is a vacuum solution, for any Lambda

exponentialHistory.history: a4 = AA H x4 + a0, b4 = b4(0) e^(be AA H x4): ad1 = AA H, ad2 = 0, uu = be AA H, vv = 0, kk = (e^{2 a0}/b4(0)) e^{(2 - be) AA H x4} (constant exactly for be = 2 or AA = 0); 3-space scale factor e^{AA H x4}, the block (x0, x5, x6, x7) e^{-(1 - be/2) AA H x4}

authorWeights.statement: the record's history a4 = H x4, b4 = b4(0) e^((4/3) H x4) needs a diagonal, x0-independent source with p0 = p_t that grows with x4 (powers of kk = e^{(2/3) H x4}); it is not a vacuum solution and is used as a PRESCRIBED background (SPEC section 1)
authorWeights.vacuum: no exponential history is a vacuum solution for the author's weights

exponentialHistory.einsteinGaussBonnetVacuum: alpha1 = 1, alpha3 = 0: no vacuum exponential history where kk varies; for constant kk = k0 > 0 (be = 2, any AA) exactly k0 != AA^2, alpha2 = -1/(4 H^2 (AA^2 - k0)), Lambda = -E^x4_x4 at the history

lemmas.gravityTerm: gamma^mu Omega_mu = (3/2) H e^{a4} b4^{-1/2} gamma^x0 + (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) gamma^x4 (canonical spin connection; Omega_x4 = 0, Omega_x0 = (1/2) cot z e^{-a4} b4^{1/2} hh gamma^x0 gamma^x4)
lemmas.diagonalKinetic: {gamma^mu, Omega_mu} = 0 for each mu (no sum), so K^mu_mu = (1/2)(Psibar gamma^mu d_mu Psi - d_mu Psibar gamma^mu Psi) contains no spin connection; for a configuration independent of x_mu, K^mu_mu = 0
lemmas.traceOnShell: sum_mu K^mu_mu = (m + U'(S)) S on shell (both statistics), so the on-shell Lagrangian is L = S U'(S) - U(S)

fields.emtConvention: T^mu_nu = sigmaT ( -K^(mu_nu) + delta^mu_nu L ), K^mu_nu = (1/2)(Psibar gamma^mu D_nu Psi - D_nu Psibar gamma^mu Psi), symmetrised; sigmaT = +1 is the convention of SPEC section 4 (homogeneous on-shell states: rho = m S + U, p = S U' - U)

generalFormulas.kmu: k_mu = K^mu_mu (no sum) = (1/2)(Psibar gamma^mu d_mu Psi - d_mu Psibar gamma^mu Psi); L = k0+k1+k2+k3+k4+k5+k6+k7 - m S - U(S) (on shell S U'(S) - U(S))
generalFormulas.offDiagonal: T^mu_nu = -sigmaT K^(mu_nu) for mu != nu must vanish (0 = kappa T^mu_nu), and the field equations need p0 = p_t

dirac16complex00.statement: classical commuting Phi; k_mu, S, U are classical bilinears
dirac16complex00.homogeneousCondensate: Phi = Phi(x4) on shell, independent of x0..x3, x5..x7: d4 Phi = A Phi, A = B - (b4'/b4 - a4'/2) I16, B = -M gamma^x4 + (3/2) H e^{a4} b4^{-1/2} gamma^x4 gamma^x0, M = m + U'(S): Phi = e^{a4/2} b4^{-1} chi with chi' = B chi (B^2 = ((9/4) H^2 kk - M^2) I16); S = e^{a4} b4^{-2} S0 (exact); the diagonal kinetic components are K^x4_x4 = M S and 0 for every other direction, and K^x4_x0 = K^x0_x4 = 0; hence rho = sigmaT (m S + U(S)), p3 = p_t = p0 = sigmaT (S U'(S) - U(S))
dirac16complex00.offDiagonalConditions: the off-diagonal field equations 0 = kappa T^mu_nu require the 24 bilinears B_abc = Phibar gamma^a gamma^b gamma^c Phi (frame gammas) with {a,b,c} = {x0, i, x4}, {x0, i, t}, {i, x4, t}, {x0, x4, t} (i = x1..x3, t = x5..x7) to vanish
dirac16complex00.offDiagonalWitness: on the histories with constant kk = k0 (b4 = e^{2 a4}/k0, any a4) and constant M: exact solutions with all 24 bilinears zero and S != 0, Phi = e^{a4/2} b4^{-1} e^{-i w x4} Phi0, w = sqrt(M^2 - (9/4) H^2 k0) (M^2 > (9/4) H^2 k0), Phi0 = v1 + c v2 from the two eigenvectors of B for -i w with gamma^x1 gamma^x5 = gamma^x2 gamma^x6 = gamma^x3 gamma^x7 = -1 and +1, c = conj(v1^dagger C v2); checked exactly at (M, H, k0) = (5, 1, 4), (5, 4/3, 4), (-5, 1, 4) (wolfram report, condensate_witness_constant_k_exact); for kk not constant not decided
dirac16complex00.asSource: the condensate source has p3 = p_t = p0 and no off-diagonal component: it needs sum_k alpha_k (E^x1_x1 - E^x0_x0) = 0; on the exponential histories: no solution in Einstein gravity; for the author's weights only on constant-kk histories, kk = (16 + 2 AA^2)/(2 + AA^2) with be = 2 and kk = 8 with AA = 0 (static), where the x4 and x0 equations further need U(S) = c - m S for AA != 0 (S = e^{a4} b4^{-2} S0 varies) and fix S0 for AA = 0 (wolfram report, condensate_source_equal_pressures); histories that are not exponential are not decided

dirac16complex.statement: quantised Psi (SPEC section 6): every bilinear is replaced by the expectation value of the normal-ordered operator in the state, <:k_mu:>, <:S:>, <:U(S):> (note <U(S)> != U(<S>) in general); the trace identity sum_mu <:k_mu:> = <:(m + U'(S)) S:> for the normal-ordered operators of the field on a whole slice is ASSUMED here, not proved. It is decided only in a finite model, by Revision/theory/fock_quartic (reports/fock-quartic.json: one good-sector plane-wave mode set with frozen coefficients, flat frame, volume 1, 16 modes, 2^16 states, U = (lambda/2) S^2 with symbolic lambda). Nothing is proved for the field on a whole slice (many momenta), for the curved x0 dependence, or for the extra-time sector
dirac16complex.offDiagonal: every off-diagonal expectation value <:T^mu_nu:> (mu != nu) must vanish, and <:p0:> = <:p_t:>
dirac16complex.kohnSham: Kohn-Sham source (Revision/kohn_sham): rho_KS(x4), p3_KS(x4), p_t_KS(x4), p0_KS(x4) from the occupied Kohn-Sham orbitals; with this source the equations of generalSource apply with these entries; the source conditions (no off-diagonal component, p0 = p_t, x0-independence) are evaluated in Revision/field_equations_a4/reports/ks-source-conditions.json
